notes: Mire Wetwell Reactor, 4x4: a teal casing round a round water well; the amber core glows under the water, bubbles rise and a steam puff leaves each corner vent in turn (the 4-frame loop), brass hand-wheel valves on the four pipes. Off: the core is dark under still water. Damaged: a feed pipe has burst and jets steam, the casing is cracked and the core stutters. Disabled: the well is drained, the dead core sits dry and cracked, a pipe snapped. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
